selection_reasoning: These tasks form a natural dependency chain centered around cows. To drink a milk bucket, the player must locate a cow and use a bucket on it. Once the player has found the cow area, they can obtain leather (cows are the source of leather) which they then sell to a leatherworker villager. The 'drink milk_bucket' task ensures the player discovers and interacts with cows first, which is a logical prerequisite for obtaining leather to sell. This creates an observable, verifiable multi-hop sequence: find cow → drink milk → obtain leather → find villager → sell leather.

edges.reason: Drinking milk requires finding cows first; cows are the source of leather needed to sell to the leatherworker villager

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has to check for an empty bucket (min_count=1). The player starts with a milk_bucket (NOT a regular bucket), so this rule is FALSE at game start. When the player drinks the milk_bucket (right-click/use), it is consumed and replaced by an empty bucket in inventory. This creates a clean FALSE→TRUE transition that uniquely detects the drinking action. inventory_has is chosen because the drinking result (empty bucket appearing) directly manifests in inventory.

Uses inventory_has to check that the player has at least 11 emeralds. The player starts with exactly 10 emeralds and 6 leather. The leatherworker villager has a custom trade: 6 leather → 1 emerald. After completing this trade, the player's emerald count increases from 10 to 11. No other emerald sources exist in the scene (no chests, no other villagers, cows don't drop emeralds), so reaching 11 emeralds uniquely indicates the leather sale was completed. inventory_has is chosen because the trade result (emerald gain) directly manifests in inventory.

scene_description: A flat grassy area with a cow pen (2 cows in oak fences) to the east and a leatherworker villager in a small oak shelter to the west. Player spawns in the middle with a milk_bucket (ready to drink), 6 leather (for selling), and 10 emeralds. Task 1: Drink the milk bucket. Task 2: Sell leather to the leatherworker villager.
task_text: First, drink your milk bucket. Then, sell your leather to the leatherworker villager nearby.
design_notes: Player spawns at center of 21x21 flat grass area. Cow pen is ~5 blocks east with 2 stationary cows (for atmosphere/context). Leatherworker villager is ~6 blocks west in oak shelter with cauldron workstation. Player has milk_bucket (for drinking), 6 leather (exact amount for trade), and 10 emeralds. Milestone 1 checks for bucket appearing (from drinking milk). Milestone 2 checks for emerald count reaching 11 (from selling leather). The dependency is enforced by task ordering - player should drink milk first, then sell leather.
